# Summary

The Iconic Species (ICO) subgoal of Sense of Place captures the condition of iconic species that are relevant to local cultural identity.  We must (1) create a list of iconic species and which OHI regions they belong to, (2) determine their condition by their risk status, such as from NOM-059-SEMARNAT-2010, or IUCN, and (3) then, for each region, the average of the status for all iconic species can be calculated.

(1) = script1_iconic_species_list.qmd
(2) = script2_norma059.qmd, script3_cites_prep.qmd, script4_iucn_prep.qmd
(3) = script5_ico_current_status.qmd

In this third script, we will be cleaning up CITES information and assessing iconic species condition based on the Appendix the species is listed under.

Note that if none of the iconic species are listed on NOM-059-SEMARNAT-2010, we will check to see if they are listed as *at risk* by CITES/IUCN.  If not, the subgoal would have a current status of 100 for that region and year.

## Bring in CITES groxx exports downloaded from the database.

Downloaded on 041026. <https://trade.cites.org/en/cites_trade/>. Specify the "Exporter = Mexico", and leave everything else leave as is. Download in 5 year increments so as to not overwhelm the site.

#### 2010_2015

```{r}
gross_exports_raw_2010_2015 <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/CITES", "gross_exports_2026-04-02 00_13_comma_separated_2010_2015.csv")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2010`:`2015`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "export_quantity"
  ) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()
```

#### 2015_2020

```{r}
gross_exports_raw_2015_2020 <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/CITES","gross_exports_2026-04-01 23_57_comma_separated_2015_2020.csv")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2015`:`2020`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "export_quantity"
  ) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()
```


#### 2020_2025

```{r}
gross_exports_raw_2020_2025 <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/CITES","gross_exports_2026-04-01 23_53_comma_separated_2020_2025.csv")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2020`:`2025`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "export_quantity"
  ) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()
```


### Merge 2015 to 2025

```{r}
gross_exports_raw_2010_2025 <- bind_rows(gross_exports_raw_2010_2015, gross_exports_raw_2015_2020, gross_exports_raw_2020_2025) %>% 
   mutate(taxon_scientific_name = str_replace_all(taxon, "spp.",""), # clean up any general genus names
         taxon_scientific_name = str_trim(taxon_scientific_name, side = "both"))

## we actually do not care about exports in this case, just whether the species is listed.  So lets isolate the species name, year listed, and appendix listing.
species_cites_mx <- gross_exports_raw_2010_2025 %>% 
  dplyr::select(taxon_scientific_name, app, year) %>% 
  distinct()
```

### Filter to ICO

```{r}
ico_spp_rgnid <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/sp/ico/int","ico_species_rgnid_040626.csv"))
```

```{r}
ico_cites_2010_2025 <- inner_join(species_cites_mx, ico_spp_rgnid, relationship = "many-to-many") 

setdiff(unique(species_cites_mx$taxon_scientific_name), unique(ico_spp_rgnid$taxon_scientific_name))
setdiff(unique(ico_spp_rgnid$taxon_scientific_name), unique(species_cites_mx$taxon_scientific_name))
```

## Assign condition

```{r}
unique(ico_cites_2010_2025$app)
# [1] "I"  "II"

ico_cites_2010_2025_condition <- ico_cites_2010_2025 %>% 
  
  # full_join(especies_iconicas_scinames_join) %>% 
  mutate(w_cat = case_when(
    
    app == "I" ~ 0.30,
    app == "II" ~ 0.60,
    TRUE ~ 1.0 # aka, if it is NA for the appendix listing, then it should have a 1... there should not be any NAs though.
    
  )) %>% 
  rename(w_cat_cites = w_cat,
         appendix_listing = app)

# write_csv(ico_cites_2010_2025_condition, here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/sp/ico/int","cites_condition_ico_spp_040726.csv"))
```
